repositoryAdminDecision: A personal repository has one owner. Multiple repository admins require an owner-approved organization-owned arrangement; no ownership transfer or organization creation is authorized or performed by this request.
projectAdminDecision: The current Project owner/admin may grant anyx05 Admin through Project Manage access. Repository write access and token scopes do not themselves grant it.
reviewPolicy: The prepared policy requires one independent review, including for administrators. Admin access does not count as self-approval; no approval bypass has been introduced. Any change requires an explicit owner/team policy decision.
